newsitem.title: USA: NASD investigates Dean Witter fund sales - WSJ.
newsitem.headline: NASD investigates Dean Witter fund sales - WSJ.

text.p: The National Association of Securities Dealers is investigating Dean Witter Discover & Co over selling practices related to a $2 billion series of bond funds, the Wall Street Journal said on Tuesday.

According to people familiar with the matter, NASD is examining if Dean Witter brokers told clients about investment risks when selling the firm's TCW/DW Term Trust 2000 Series of funds, the paper said in its electronic edition.
These closed-end bond funds trade on the New York Stock
NASD was also investigating whether Dean Witter brokers promised investors a guaranteed return on the term trusts, the paper said.
Dean Witter was not immediately available to comment.

In the paper, Dean Witter was quoted as saying: "Both the prospectus and sales literature prepared by Dean Witter made clear that there was no assurance that the trust's investment objectives could be achieved and that the trusts could, under some circumstances, return less than $10 per share on the termination date."
